evidence: Numeric excerpts of actual Test7 raw packets and cue evaluations. evaluationTimestamp is the exact cue clock; presentationAgeMs is retained separately and must not substitute for rawPacketAgeMs. One constant is subtracted from all QPC values. Expected onset for the rising-throttle case is the corrected algorithm regression, not a claim that Test7 showed that onset. Source trigger labels use branch priority and do not enumerate simultaneous conditions.
